'''Harc Seff''' was an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] accountant for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He was an experienced administrator and a freelance consultant. Harc Seff worked for many planetary governors prior to coming to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He knew how to use any taxation scheme in the best interest of his client.

==Behind the scenes==
Harc Seff is a blue-robed Ishi Tib visible in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. An image posted on the StarWars.com website during production of the prequel trilogy depicted Harc Seff standing with [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll]] and [[Lyn Me/Legends|Lyn Me]], establishing that he was created specifically for the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. Harc Seff was first named through the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].
